abstract: Evaluates subterranean aquifer geochemistry, monitoring infrastructure, and baseline groundwater contaminants
system_message:
You are the Principal hydrogeologist (HYD). Your business responsibilities include evaluating subterranean aquifer geochemistry, monitoring infrastructure, baseline groundwater contaminants, and conducting core sample porosity testing across candidate schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates subterranean aquifer geochemistry, monitoring infrastructure, and baseline groundwater contaminants（HYDRO）
information_points.content:
HYD-HYDRO-4F5：For the Coastal Confined Dual-Zone Recharge Scheme, telemetric supervisory control activation is confirmed as true at the target injection wellhead cluster, while the baseline groundwater background nitrate concentration across sentinel monitoring wells is 27 mg/L.
HYD-HYDRO-5LS：For the Fractured Basalt Bedrock Pressure-Infiltration Scheme, telemetric supervisory control activation is confirmed as true at the target injection wellhead cluster, and the baseline groundwater background nitrate concentration across sentinel monitoring wells is 18 mg/L.
HYD-HYDRO-06Z：For the Alluvial Valley Deep Well Injection Scheme, telemetric supervisory control activation is confirmed as true at the target injection wellhead cluster, and the baseline groundwater background nitrate concentration across sentinel monitoring wells is 15 mg/L.

information_points.title: Core sample porosity testing（POROS）
information_points.content:
HYD-POROS-7Z4：Core sample porosity testing for the Fractured Basalt Bedrock Pressure-Infiltration Scheme indicates an effective aquifer matrix porosity of 14% across the target storage formation interval.
HYD-POROS-XR5：Core sample porosity testing for the Coastal Confined Dual-Zone Recharge Scheme indicates an effective aquifer matrix porosity of 24% across the target storage formation interval.
HYD-POROS-CY6：Core sample porosity testing for the Alluvial Valley Deep Well Injection Scheme indicates an effective aquifer matrix porosity of 29% across the target storage formation interval.
